title: Pensacola Case Resolution (Eglin)
doc_notes: This document is an AARO case resolution report regarding a UAP sighting near Eglin Air Force Base, including figures and technical assessments.

incidents.summary: A military pilot reported four potential UAP in the Eglin Air Force Base training range, with one object visually and sensor-tracked.
incidents.color: gray with orange-red coloring at the center
incidents.explanation: Very likely a lighter-than-air object, such as a large commercial lighting balloon.
incidents.location_name: Eglin Air Force Base training range, Florida
incidents.quote: A military pilot reported the object due to its potential as a flight safety hazard
